subject: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@clearwayhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising for our triage workflows. Before we commit to a pilot, Samir and I want to align on what success looks like and the checkpoints we need to see to move to procurement.

Can you share a proposed set of evaluation signals (both qualitative and quantitative), explicit exit gates, and a suggested timeline for a 6-week trial? Key constraints: PHI handling, peak-hour latency under 450ms 95th, and evidence for model behavior on adverse clinical prompts.

We're hoping for a short mutual action plan we can take back to our security and procurement teams. If you have a short checklist or a one-page acceptance test plan that would help speed internal approvals.

Thanks — Emily

Emily Tran
Director of Clinical Engineering, Clearway Health
emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan

Hi Emily — great to connect.

Filing a short MAP draft for you (attached: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) that breaks down:
- Acceptance signals (SLOs + sample prompts)
- Exit gates (hard stops for PHI risk, latency, concordance)
- Acceptance tests (smoke, regression, adversarial prompts)
- Evidence owners and artifacts (logs, eval reports, annotated examples)

High-level proposal (6-week pilot):
Week 0: Kickoff & data/security checklist (we'll supply a security evidence pack)
Weeks 1–3: Integration + smoke tests and baseline evals (we'll run 3 synthetic prompt suites)
Weeks 4–5: Production-like load runs (peak-hour sampling + latency SLO checks)
Week 6: Acceptance review and signoff or targeted remediation plan

Proposed acceptance thresholds (draft):
- Latency: 95th <= 450ms for 8k token/hour slice (measured at edge)
- Concordance: >= 92% on your clinical QA set (we'll help seed examples)
- Safety/PHI: zero PHI exfiltration incidents in 2500 sampled responses OR documented redaction pass in pipeline

Open items for you:
1) Do you have an internal clinical QA set we can use (even a small one, 200 examples)?
2) Any required additional audit logs beyond our standard request/response + KV cache events?

I'll loop Priyom to capture the operational owners and Marcus for performance validation. Quick note: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx includes a one-page acceptance checklist you can present to procurement.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(t) 650-555-0133
Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwayhealth.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan

Thanks Tessa — this is exactly the format we need. A couple of clarifications from security/procurement after a quick sync:
- We will share a 250-sample clinical QA set (deidentified) by EOD Monday.
- We need a short security Q&A and a copy of the SOC-2 summary; can you advise on evidence artifacts?

Attached: security_q_and_a.pdf (our internal list of questions). Samir flagged an item: we need a demo of redaction behavior for injected PHI prompts — is that already part of your smoke tests?

If you can confirm those two items and update the MAP so the procurement checklist calls out the DocuSign-ready acceptance statement, we can tentatively pencil in the kickoff for 2026-09-08.

Best,
Emily

Attachment: security_q_and_a.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan

Emily — looping in the operational steps and owners. Quick checklist (we'll drop into the MAP spreadsheet as a separate tab):
- Evidence pack we will provide before kickoff: SOC2 summary, data retention policy, redaction design doc, request/response audit sample (owner: Priyom)
- PHI redaction smoke test: yes — included in Week 1 smoke tests (owner: Marcus)
- Performance validation artifact: multi-run p95/p99 trace and KV cache hit-rate (owner: Marcus)
- Acceptance statement (DocuSign): we will place a one-line acceptance clause in the close_agenda.docx and provide a DocuSign link (owner: Tessa)

Proposed owners and timeline (short):
- Kickoff (2026-09-08) — Tessa (runbook + integration)
- Week 1 smoke tests & redaction demo (2026-09-09 -> 09-15) — Marcus
- Week 2–3 baseline evals (09-16 -> 09-29) — Redwood Eval Team / Clearway reviewers
- Week 4 production load and audit sampling (09-30 -> 10-06) — Marcus & Clearway ops
- Week 5 signoff review & DocuSign (10-07 -> 10-08) — Tessa / Emily

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890 (HubSpot deal), DocuSign placeholder will be posted after the kickoff.

I'll attach the short close_agenda.docx for the acceptance clause.

— Priyom
Attachment: close_agenda.docx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwayhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@clearwayhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mapping success indicators and close milestone plan

Appreciate the clear owners and cadence. Confirming Clearway is good to kickoff on 2026-09-08. A couple quick asks before kickoff:
- Can Redwood provide an example of the redaction demo script you'll run (we want to include our compliance engineer on the call)?
- In the acceptance checklist, can you add a pass/fail rubric for adverse prompt handling (we prefer a 3-tier: Pass / Needs remediation / Fail with explicit remediation window)?

If you can add those two items into the MAP_draft_v1.xlsx and circulate an updated HubSpot link, we'll move procurement to issuance on receipt of the DocuSign acceptance statement.

Thanks,
Samir
Clinical Ops Manager, Clearway Health
samir.patel@clearwayhealth.com
